column1: # ---- MULTI-ORGAN AUTOPSY (brain-heavy): Oliver 2025 Nat Genet, PMC11906363, 10.1038/s41588-025-02097-2 ----
# THE BIGGEST PRIZE. 3 NF1 patients autopsied and LCM'd across 26-48 DISTINCT ANATOMICAL SITES each:
# spinal cord, peripheral nerve (sciatic/optic/trigeminal/dorsal root ganglion), adrenal, kidney,
# liver, spleen, skin, thyroid, bladder, stomach, bowel, heart, muscle, trachea, bronchus.
# NO TREES PUBLISHED - repo github.com/trwo/nf1_second_hit_normal_tissues has 8 files, none are trees.
# CAVEAT: NF1 germline patients; a subset of sites are TUMOUR (glioma). Sites are labelled in Supp Table 1.
# BRAIN IS WHERE SOMATIC L1 RETROTRANSPOSITION IS REPORTED TO BE ACTIVE -- highest-value target for us.
# ---- INFANT KIDNEY / WILMS: Lee-Six 2025 Nat Commun, PMC12122882, 10.1038/s41467-025-59854-4 ----
# Newick strings are IN the supplement (MOESM4, sheets fig2 + supp_fig8) and R scripts are at
# github.com/HLee-Six/infant_Wilms. MOSTLY TUMOUR samples -- limited value as "normal organ".
# "Sc-organoid" = single-cell-derived organoid WGS (literally single-cell-derived organ material).
# THYROID (Nature 2026, PMC13233322, thyroid autoimmunity / Hashimoto + Graves):
#   -> 69 Targeted + 17 Exome, ZERO WGS. Verified from Supp Table (MOESM3, sequencing_type col).
#      Thyroid is an uncovered organ but there is no WGS to call insertions in. Skip.
# NF1 targeted-only cases (PMC11906363 Supp Tables 16/17): PD61044 PD61045 PD61046 PD61047
#   PD61049 PD61050 PD61051 PD61052 PD61053  -> `tds` targeted duplex on muscle etc. No WGS.
# LUNG basal (PMC7617789): the ids PD0223/PD37786/PD5195/PD6333/PD6378/PD7371 that a naive
#   grep returns ARE NOT REAL. They are fragments inside base64-encoded images in the
#   supplement. Structured-table-only extraction returns ZERO ids for this paper.
#   *** ALWAYS extract PD ids from xl/sharedStrings.xml / tsv / csv ONLY. Never grep a PDF,
#   an HTML, or a whole supplement dir -- base64 blobs manufacture plausible fake PD ids. ***
# BULK TUMOUR COHORTS (not normal-organ phylogenies; thousands of ids, wrong experiment):
